name: 32968 · Vero Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 32968 (Vero Beach) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (53% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32968 (Vero Beach) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
